title: UNVERIFIED — Nodestar

features.name: a new variation of module, seen only from a distance
features.desc-on-touch: One of many seen in the intervening years, like lodestars, although when he said the word in his head he said nodestars. He did not take it down. He did not open it.

features.name: a nest of wrens, imagined
features.desc-on-touch: He imagines opening it up and finding little birds talking very fast. Soft teak kinetic batteries.

features.name: a tartan of some kind
features.desc-on-touch: Love is a network that supplies its own meaning.

features.name: a bowser, a motorbike
features.desc-on-touch: He fills up and thinks back to the module. A scale map of all his past interiorities, crossed by pinballing between motels and service stations.

inscription: love is the word we give to being wrong about our capacity for solitude

file.name: Nodestar_maker_unrecorded.txt
file.note: Not his operation. The casing is different now. Somebody is still working.
